Union Street Olean, NY 14760 4th Floor | Suite 401 top of page Home About Us Laine Place Our Programs and Services Blog Contact Donate Olean Business Development Corporation Propelling Business and Community Development in the Greater Olean Area Contact Us 400+ Companies Served 10+ Years of Experience 100+ Programs Deployed Who We Are Olean Business Development Corporation (OBDC) is a 501(c)(3) not-for-profit dedicated to the continued development of the Entrepreneurial Ecosystem in the greater Olean area. OBDC strives to help entrepreneurs and small business owners throughout their business journey, from startup to transition, by deploying programming, establishing connections to other support organizations that OBDC partners with, and continuous contact with these business owners. Our Impact Our small town is full of big ideas, driven by amazing entrepreneurs and small business owners. Our programs and services have led to over 100 jobs being created in the Olean region, with increased revenue for these business owners, maintaining this impactful small business footprint in our region, and keeping these much-needed services in our communities. 8 Businesses Selected for 2026 Laine Business Accelerator Cohort top of page Home About Us Laine Place Our Programs and Services Blog Contact Donate All Posts News Laine Business Accelerator Our Additional Programs Annual Reports Search 8 Businesses Selected for 2026 Laine Business Accelerator Cohort Wixspace Digital Aug 17 2 min read Updated: Oct 7 By JOHN BARTIMOLE | Special to Olean Times Herald August 15, 2026 OLEAN — Olean Business Development Corporation announced the selection of eight businesses for the sixth cohort of its signature program, the Laine Business Accelerator , continuing the entrepreneurial legacy of Erick Laine, former CEO of Cutco Corporation. The 2026 cohort brings together businesses representing a diverse range of industries from across the region. Each participating business will receive $5,000 in seed funding and take part in a multi-week program of education, mentorship, peer collaboration, and strategic business development. “We continue to be excited by the growth of the entrepreneurial community and ecosystem in the greater Olean region,” said Bob Forness, president and executive director of OBDC. “This year’s cohort represents another strong group of business owners, and we look forward to working with them as they identify opportunities to strengthen and grow their businesses.” The businesses selected for the 2026 Laine Business Accelerator
